OFFLINE EXPERIMENT · NOT ENABLED IN THE STABILIZER

Whole-reference correction comparison

The current rigid-only build failed the requested visual result. This experiment changes the recorded light profile using a filter applied across each entire frame.

Reference region, every frame

Left: the current rigid frame shift. Right: the restoration experiment. Both show the same fixed 65 × 65 pixel region, enlarged 6×, through all 349 frames.

What changes

This applies a global filter estimated from the selected light. It changes pixel values, noise, and apparent image detail. It can produce ringing. The reference region is processed as part of the whole frame. The original video is preserved.

This remains an experimental result. It has not passed the full zero-shake requirement and is not a faithful rigid-only transformation.
